summary: Develop market maps, buyer links and practical action plans for rural trade. Explore the five-day course outline and assess its fit.
lede: Rural market development training helps practitioners assess market constraints and improve rural suppliers’ participation in trade. For market development officers, value-chain advisers and producer-organization business advisers, it covers value-chain mapping, market and price information, and identifying buyer requirements. Participants use these capabilities to strengthen collective marketing and plan market interventions with partners.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who assess rural market constraints, facilitate producer-buyer relationships and support businesses to participate in trade. It suits intermediate-level professionals with responsibilities in market access, value-chain performance or producer-group commercial capacity.
prerequisites: Prior experience in rural markets, producer support, trade facilitation or value-chain work is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use market information, spreadsheets and presentation software.
